milestone: known-bad fixture — four recorded failure modes, one per capability

capabilities.name: directory that does not exist
capabilities.excludes: nothing — the path is the whole population
capabilities.remedy: create the directory, or correct the path in the manifest

negative_control.why: a missing path must not list

capabilities.name: counted nothing and called it green
capabilities.population: records in the scratch dir carrying a prior-season slot
capabilities.excludes: records with no prior-season slot — which is every case this check exists to catch
capabilities.remedy: widen the population to all records, then re-run

capabilities.name: api auth that a public endpoint answers
capabilities.population: the one league id the probe names
capabilities.excludes: every other league; every other endpoint on the API
capabilities.remedy: probe an endpoint that returns 401 without a credential, then re-run

negative_control.why: the same request with no credential must not succeed

capabilities.name: device bridge filed as a tooling limit
capabilities.remedy: connect the folder in the bridge's settings — this was never a tooling limit
